items.raw_excerpt: Ahead of TWS’ first-ever concert in Singapore on Oct 10, the sextet spoke with CNA Lifestyle about their hopes for their maiden show here.
items.summary_en: TWS is a six-member K-pop boy group. Their debut song became a big streaming hit in South Korea. The group will hold its first concert in Singapore on October 10.

items.raw_excerpt: Joaquín Larrivey, delantero argentino de Deportes Concepción, fue la figura de la goleada 4-0 ante Curicó Unido tras marcar un doblete en el compromiso válido por la ida de los octavos de final en la Copa Chile. El resto de las anotaciones fueron convertidas por Norman Rodríguez y Misael Dávila.
items.summary_en: Joaquin Larrivey scored twice for Deportes Concepcion in a 4-0 win over Curico Unido. He was the star of the Copa Chile match. Norman Rodriguez and Misael Davila scored the other goals.

items.title_en: Larrivey Scores Twice as Deportes Concepcion Wins 4-0

items.raw_excerpt: Tonga and Samoa believe the next few months will be critical as they build-up to the 2027 Netball World Cup.
items.summary_en: Tonga and Samoa say the next few months will be key as they build up to the 2027 Netball World Cup. The two Pacific rivals are now focused on training and picking their squads. Fans at home will watch how far each team can go.

items.raw_excerpt: If you're dreaming of trading the city for a quieter life in Ontario, this charming village might be worth checking out.
items.summary_en: Many Canadians say they would love to leave the city for a quiet life in a small village in Ontario. Fenelon Falls sits between two lakes and is known for its waterfall and old homes. Homes there cost less than in big Canadian cities.

items.raw_excerpt: Liquidators surrender the leases of a central Queensland coal mine, with questions around who will manage and pay for the rehabilitation of the site.
items.summary_en: The company that owned a coal mine near Bowen in Queensland has given up its lease and will not pay for the clean-up. The state government must now repair the site. Local people want to know who will manage the work and how long it will take.

items.raw_excerpt: Los azules medirán fuerzas con los viñamarinos este jueves en Sausalito. La revancha será el domingo en el Nacional.
items.summary_en: Universidad de Chile plays Chilean club Everton de Vina del Mar at Sausalito on Thursday. The second leg is on Sunday at the National Stadium. Both sides want an early edge in the round of 16 tie.

items.raw_excerpt: Der Traditionsort zeigt sich innovativ: Das Iglu-Dorf in Davos bietet Whirlpool, Iglu-Suite, Fonduepartys und vieles mehr! Da die 11 einzelnen Iglus mit Gängen verbunden sind und insgesamt für 44 Personen Platz bieten, eignet sich das Davoser Iglu-Dorf gut für ein Gruppenerlebnis oder einen Firmenausflug.
items.summary_en: The igloo village in Davos has 11 igloos joined by tunnels. It sleeps up to 44 guests in total. Guests can enjoy a warm bath, a private igloo suite, and fondue parties. It fits well for a group trip or a company outing.

items.raw_excerpt: The National Farmers Federation and the federal government have reached a short-term agreement to fast-track urgent visa requests for backpacker workers.
items.summary_en: Australian farmers and the federal government made a short-term deal. Urgent visa requests for backpacker farm workers will now be handled faster. The goal is to get workers onto farms sooner.

items.raw_excerpt: An expert says it's possible a fireball seen over the North Island on Wednesday night left behind space rocks for scientists to examine, and enthusiasts to look at - but not touch.
items.summary_en: A very bright fireball crossed the night sky above Mount Taranaki on Wednesday. An expert says it may have dropped space rocks onto the ground. Scientists want to find and study them, but people are asked not to touch them.
items.summary_ko: 수요일 밤 타라나키 산 상공에 아주 밝은 화염구가 나타났다. 전문가가 이 화염구가 지면에 우주 암석을 남겼을 가능성이 있다고 말했다. 과학자들은 이를 찾아 연구하려 하지만, 사람들이 함부로 손대지 말아야 한다.
items.title_en: Fireball Lights Up Sky Above Mount Taranaki
items.title_original: 'Bright as': Fireball lights up skies above Taranaki Maunga

items.raw_excerpt: La normativa, ya publicada en el Diario Oficial, busca prevenir caídas accidentales de niños y personas con necesidades especiales desde departamentos y edificaciones en altura. La normativa exigirá medidas de protección a propietarios y arrendatarios en inmuebles ubicados sobre el primer piso donde residan menores de 12 años.
items.summary_en: Chile published a new safety rule for buildings. Homes with children under 12 that are above the first floor may need window guards. The rule also makes owners and tenants share the duty to keep homes safe.
items.summary_ko: 칠레가 건물을 대상으로 한 새로운 안전 규칙을 공식 gazette에.publish했다. 1층 이상에 12세 미만 아이가 사는 집에는 창문 안전망을 설치해야 할 수 있다. 소유자와 임차인이 함께 집을 안전하게 관리할 의무도 규정에 담겼다.
items.title_en: New Rule May Require Fall Guards on Apartment Windows
